description: Client project contract for MCP routes, deterministic Python inputs, API response gaps, and derived outputs. Salesforce object and relationship truth lives in schema-mapping.json.

canonical_provider_risk_payment_contract.provenance: Every result returns the applied rule_version and source_readiness. Blocked and duplicate outcomes never include an amount.

payment_analysis_views.NEXT_PAYOUT: Select the next unpaid service period after today and return service and payment dates plus deterministic amount status.
payment_analysis_views.CURRENT_WEEK_FORECAST: Analyze the service period containing today; actuals through today are combined with future scheduled hours as conditional SCHEDULED_FORECAST rows.
payment_analysis_views.what_if: Unsupported until an explicit scenario input schema and deterministic adapter are approved.

payout_calculator_status.blocker: Live Apex responses do not yet provide the approved fiscal-rate, parent-confirmation, payment-status, and transaction-level fields required for a production payout calculation.

canonical_engine_status.blocker: MCP response schemas do not yet supply complete normalized fiscal-rate, transaction, confirmation, payment-history, slot-contract, and parent-fee inputs.

normalized_inputs.rate_resolution: Provider -> active fiscal agreement -> rating-level rate schedule -> fiscal rate

attendance_analysis_source.scope: Configured provider identity is resolved by initialize; the client injects only provider IDs returned by initialization.

response.parent_confirmation_source: Status__c; PARENT_APPROVED confirms, PARENT_PENDING remains pending, and PARENT_REJECTED is excluded from valid attendance.
response.missing_data_behavior: A missing or incompatible Attendance__r collection emits a per-record data_quality_blockers entry. The deterministic analyzer excludes the affected schedule from attendance conclusions and returns the blocker.

attendance_analysis_source.payment_status: Payment status, next-payout detail, and current-week forecast require complete canonical fiscal, attendance, confirmation, and payment-history inputs; incomplete inputs fail closed without an amount.

getProviderData: Returns provider, fiscal agreement, nested rate-schedule, and closure records, but does not return fiscal-rate rows; rate-schedule external IDs are selected for the scoped fiscal-rate request.
Provider.Program_Name__c is used by getSchedules but is not included in the provider SELECT; getSchedules re-queries it.
Fiscal agreement external IDs are not selected in the response.
getCaseData: Returns raw case records with Id, Name, county, external ID, and filtered CaseIndividuals__r children.
IDN_PROVR__c is used as a numeric provider filter but is not selected into the case response.
Case-individual rows expose client ID, demographic fields, caretaker flag, effective dates, and status, but not a normalized child object.
getAuthData: Returns selected authorization fields plus related provider, child, county, slot-contract, facility, and child-name values as raw SObject output.
Returns slotContracts for linked T_SLOT_CONTRACT__c records, including effective dates, care unit, care level, rate type, program type, day limits, and occupancy flags.
Returns encumbrances keyed by authorization external ID with care date, authorized hours, actual attended hours, status, care unit, care level, and 0-36 enrollment indicator.
Returns authorizationCopays keyed by authorization external ID with effective dates and parent fee amount.
Authorization status is returned through an unaliased toLabel expression, so its serialized response key must be verified before normalization.
The response does not include fiscal-rate or parent-confirmation data.
getCountyData: Returns a manually normalized county-rate-plan map rather than raw T_COUNTY_RATE__c records.
These plans provide attendance/drop-in/holiday policy, not provider reimbursement fiscal rates.
The response includes dropInResponse from PAYMENT_Q14_2__c for licensed-only versus universal drop-in policy.
getServicePeriods: Returns a DTO; if no stored row matches, it generates a computed period and payment dates instead of returning a Salesforce record.
getHolidayList: Returns raw holiday records with selected code/date fields and no county relationship.
getSchedules: Forwards the external schedules response; MCP normalizes the typed schedule fields used by Python.
Attendance transactions are returned under Attendance__r.records and are mapped by MCP from the existing response.
getFiscalRates: Requires provider IDs and rate-schedule external IDs supplied by MCP from the authenticated provider initialization scope.
Re-derives active fiscal agreements and rate schedules server-side before returning batchsit_t_fiscal_rate__x rows and T_FISCAL_RAT_FEES__c rows.
Returns fiscal schedule headers, fiscal-rate rows, and fiscal-rate fee rows, including county, fiscal-agreement, and provider fee amounts; this data does not by itself enable live payout amounts.
getPaymentHistory: Requires provider IDs injected by MCP from authenticated provider initialization.
Requires a dateFilter and resolves it server-side to overlapping T_SERV_PERIOD__c external IDs before querying sub-payments.

Returns local T_PAYMT__c parent rows scoped by authenticated provider and service-period record IDs, plus read-only batchsit_t_sub_pmt__x rows scoped by the parent payment external IDs and resolved service-period IDs.
The date scope is service-period based for duplicate-payment checks; paid-date filtering is not used by this route.
Provides authorization, service-period, slot-contract, status, and amount fields for duplicate-payment checks; status-code normalization remains required.

Returns paymentDetails and paymentDetailHistory keyed to the scoped sub-payments, including care dates, additional-info codes, detail statuses, rates, copay, paid amounts, adjustment/recovery indicators, and 0-36 enrollment data.
